description: This file contains configuration utilities and functions for managing QQBot accounts within the openclaw project, including normalization, listing, resolving, and applying account configurations.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Normalizes the default account ID from raw input, trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeQQBotAccountConfig
methods.description: Normalizes a QQBot account configuration object, ensuring optional fields are handled.

methods.name: normalizeAppId
methods.description: Converts raw input to a trimmed string representing an app ID.

methods.name: listQQBotAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all configured QQBot account IDs present in the given OpenClaw configuration.

methods.name: resolveDefaultQQBotAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default QQBot account ID based on configuration and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveQQBotAccount
methods.description: Resolves a QQBot account configuration for runtime or setup, including secret management.

methods.name: applyQQBotAccountConfig
methods.description: Updates the OpenClaw configuration with new QQBot account settings.
